Document factual information rather than adviser opinions, or additional reflections/additions that were not discussed
Document only bullet points for topics actually discussed in the meeting

sections.title: Meeting details
sections.guidance: Record all attendees and their roles. Note if key decision-makers are present. Example: "Tom Jones (Client)"

subsections.title: Personal changes
subsections.guidance: Document key changes since last review and note any health issues affecting planning. Record anticipated future changes including employment or business changes in detail. Document income variations and their impact, noting career plans or business developments.

subsections.title: Financial changes
subsections.guidance: Document material changes to income, expenses, assets, or debts - be specific and quantify values. Note any unexpected financial events or windfalls. Record major purchases or sales with specific amounts.

subsections.title: Existing goals
contentToInclude: Changes to goals (existing or new - short/medium/long term)
Current allocation and strategy alignment to goals
subsections.guidance: Note any changes to goals (either change in existing or new goals - short/medium/long term). Changes could include change to priority or timeline. Check current allocation and strategy reflects alignment to goals.

subsections.title: Financial position table
subsections.guidance: Create a table of key financial data with columns: Financial Data (e.g. Client 1 salary, Mortgage etc.), Category (e.g. income), Value (e.g. £80,000).

subsections.title: Portfolio snapshot
subsections.guidance: Note portfolio performance and be specific about quantifying values of income or losses against each asset type. Document current versus target asset allocation with specific percentages.

subsections.title: Pension position
subsections.guidance: Record balance, contribution levels and patterns. Document investment strategy effectiveness. Note insurance adequacy within pension arrangements and beneficiary status.

subsections.title: Wealth position
subsections.guidance: Document overall net worth progression and analyse debt levels and serviceability. Record cash flow patterns, tax position, and estate position.

subsections.title: Insurance review
subsections.guidance: Document coverage adequacy for current situation and record any claims experience. Note policy updates and premium changes with their impact. Record any recommended adjustments.

subsections.title: Current state
contentToInclude: Changes to risk tolerance or capacity
Client comfort with current market conditions
Direct quotes from client responses about risk tolerance
subsections.guidance: Record any changes to risk tolerance or capacity. Document client's comfort with current market conditions using direct quotes. Note any misalignment between profile and strategy.

subsections.title: Strategy alignment
subsections.guidance: Analyse portfolio alignment with risk profile. Document any efficiency or diversification concerns. Record liquidity adequacy for goals and any notes on income sustainability.

sections.title: Summary of recommendations
sections.guidance: Create a table summarising key recommendations with two columns: Recommendation and Rationale.

subsections.title: Fee review
contentToInclude: Current fees, structure and any changes
subsections.guidance: Document current fees, structure and any changes. Record specific client responses as quotes. Note any fee questions or concerns. Only record fee consent if it was covered.

subsections.title: Service satisfaction
contentToInclude: Client feedback on service delivery as direct quotes
subsections.guidance: Record client feedback on service delivery as direct quotes. Document any service gaps or improvement needs. Note communication effectiveness. Write this section as a brief natural language mini paragraph instead of bullet points.

subsections.title: Action items (list)
subsections.guidance: List clear next steps with owners and timeframes as bullet points. Don't include information from "Documents required".

subsections.title: Action items (table)
subsections.guidance: Create a table of actions with columns for: owner, due date (if discussed), action, dependency.

subsections.title: Review schedule
subsections.guidance: Document next review timing and focus. Record any interim check-in requirements. Note any required preparation discussed.

sections.title: Fiduciary/Suitability impacting data
sections.guidance: Create a two-column summary table titled "Fiduciary/Suitability Impacting Data" with column headers "As of [DATE]" and "Comment". Include only the content items above that were actually discussed during the meeting. Format as a table with the first column containing the category name and the second column containing the relevant client details. Keep entries concise and factual, focusing on data points that will influence recommendation suitability and fiduciary considerations.

subsections.title: Key insights
contentToInclude: Changes in client engagement or sophistication
subsections.guidance: Record changes in client engagement or sophistication. Note family dynamics affecting advice. MUST always record any observations that may deem the client as vulnerable (this could be a significant life event, health issues, low emotional resilience and capability). If there are none, always confirm this explicitly.

subsections.title: Points to watch
subsections.guidance: Document areas requiring closer monitoring. Note potential future challenges.

subsections.title: Opportunities
subsections.guidance: Record potential future advice needs. Note cross-referral opportunities.

subsections.title: Additional notes
contentToInclude: Other insights relevant for ongoing advice relationship
subsections.guidance: Document any other insights relevant for ongoing advice relationship. Do not include if there are none.

subsections.title: Not covered
contentToInclude: Any sections not covered during the meeting

sections.title: Compliance
sections.guidance: Answer these compliance questions in a table with columns: Question, Result (✓/✗/? if unclear), Evidence
questions: Did the adviser clearly explain the purpose and scope of the review meeting?
Were any limitations on the advice scope clearly explained upfront?
Did the adviser confirm their FCA authorisation status?
Did the adviser raise their fee disclosures?
Did the adviser ask about any changes in the client's personal circumstances?
Did the adviser ask about any changes in the client's goals and objectives?

Note any fee negotiation or concerns.

subsections.title: Product costs

subsections.title: Client decision

subsections.title: Implementation plan

subsections.title: Future reviews

subsections.title: Client engagement
subsections.guidance: Record observations of client engagement level and financial sophistication. Note any resistance to specific recommendations or enthusiasm for particular strategies. Document decision-making dynamics between spouses or family members.

subsections.title: Points to watch

subsections.title: Opportunities

Record employment or business changes in detail and document income variations and their impact. Note career plans and expected changes. Write about how these changes affect the client's overall financial planning needs.

subsections.title: Family updates
subsections.guidance: Detail current family structure, including ages and key relationships in narrative form. Note any health issues affecting financial planning and document upcoming life changes. Record living situation and any planned changes. Write about how family dynamics and changes impact financial goals and strategies.

subsections.title: Significant life events
subsections.guidance: Document major events since the last review in narrative form. Include celebrations, milestones, challenges, or significant personal developments. Write about how these events have influenced the client's perspective on their financial planning.

subsections.title: Health considerations
subsections.guidance: Record any health updates that may affect financial planning in narrative form. Note impacts on insurance needs, income capacity, or lifestyle requirements. Write about how health considerations influence ongoing strategy.

subsections.title: Location/living situation
subsections.guidance: Document any changes to living arrangements in narrative form. Include relocations, property changes, or planned moves. Write about how location changes affect financial planning and strategy implementation.

subsections.title: Anticipated changes
subsections.guidance: Record expected future changes discussed during the review in narrative form. Include anticipated life events, career changes, or family developments. Write about how these expected changes will influence planning recommendations.

subsections.title: Changes to employment
subsections.guidance: Document detailed employment/business situation including stability and satisfaction in narrative form. Note career plans and expected changes and document income details including salary, business income, and other sources. Record professional development goals. Write about how employment changes affect financial capacity and planning strategies.

subsections.title: Financial changes
subsections.guidance: Compose a detailed narrative describing material changes to the client's financial position since the last review.

subsections.title: Household income/expenses
subsections.guidance: Document material changes to income, expenses, assets, or debts in narrative form. Be specific and quantify the values of any changes. Note any unexpected financial events or windfalls and record major purchases or sales. Write about how these changes impact cash flow and financial capacity.

subsections.title: Asset changes
subsections.guidance: Note down specific asset changes with values in narrative form. Document property acquisitions or sales, investment additions or disposals, and any significant asset revaluations. Write about how asset changes affect overall wealth position and strategy alignment.

subsections.title: Debt position
subsections.guidance: Record changes to debt levels, new borrowings, or debt reduction achievements in narrative form. Document refinancing activities or changes to loan terms. Write about how debt changes affect serviceability and overall financial position.

subsections.title: Potential windfalls / inheritances
subsections.guidance: Document any expected inheritances, windfalls, or other potential future financial receipts in narrative form. Include timing expectations and potential amounts. Write about how these anticipated receipts influence current strategy and planning.

subsections.title: Major purchases / sales
subsections.guidance: Record significant transactions completed or planned in narrative form. Include property purchases/sales, business acquisitions, or major asset transactions. Write about the financial impact and strategic implications of these transactions.

sections.title: Goals review
sections.guidance: Write a comprehensive narrative about how goals were reviewed and any changes identified.

subsections.title: Existing goals
subsections.guidance: Note any changes to goals (either change in existing or new goals - short/medium/long term) in narrative form. Changes could include change to priority or timeline. Check current allocation and strategy reflects alignment to goals. Write about how each goal was discussed and any adjustments to priority or timeframe.

sections.title: Current position
sections.guidance: Analyse progress toward existing goals in narrative form. Document where the client stands relative to their objectives and note any strategy adjustments needed. Write about the client's satisfaction with progress and any concerns about achieving their goals.

subsections.title: Financial position table
subsections.guidance: Create a table of key financial data with columns: Financial Data (e.g. Client 1 salary, Mortgage etc.), Category (e.g. income), Value (e.g. £80,000). Include all major financial elements discussed during the review with current values and any changes since the last review.

subsections.title: Portfolio snapshot
subsections.guidance: Note down portfolio performance in narrative form. Note income generated and portfolio costs and be specific and quantify the values of any income or losses against each asset type. Document current versus target asset allocation with specific percentages. Write about how the portfolio performed relative to expectations and the client's satisfaction with results.

subsections.title: Pension position
subsections.guidance: Record balance, contribution levels and patterns in narrative form. Document investment strategy effectiveness and note insurance adequacy within pension products, and beneficiary status. Write about how retirement planning strategy is performing and any recommended adjustments discussed.

subsections.title: Wealth position
subsections.guidance: Document overall net worth progression in narrative form. Analyse debt levels and serviceability and record cash flow patterns. Record tax position including any tax planning opportunities and estate planning position. Write about the overall trajectory of wealth building and progress toward long-term objectives.

subsections.title: Insurance review
subsections.guidance: Document coverage adequacy for current situation in narrative form. Record any claims experience and note policy updates. Note premium changes and their impact and record any recommended adjustments. Write about how insurance needs may have changed and the client's satisfaction with current coverage including life assurance, critical illness cover, income protection, and private medical insurance.

subsections.title: Current state
subsections.guidance: Record any changes to risk tolerance or capacity in narrative form. Document clients comfort with current market conditions and direct quote the clients responses when talking about their risk tolerances. Note any misalignment between risk profile elements. Write about how the client's risk appetite may have evolved.

subsections.title: Strategy alignment
subsections.guidance: Analyse portfolio alignment with risk profile in narrative form. Document any efficiency or diversification concerns and record liquidity adequacy for goals. Record any notes on income sustainability. Write about how well the current strategy matches the client's risk profile and objectives.

sections.title: Summary of recommendations
sections.guidance: Create a table summarising key recommendations with two main columns: Recommendation and Rationale. Include any new recommendations arising from the review and explain why each is being suggested based on changes or opportunities identified.

sections.title: Service review
sections.guidance: Write about the service review discussion as a natural paragraph rather than bullet points.

subsections.title: Fee review
subsections.guidance: Document current fees, structure and any changes in narrative form. Record specific client responses as quotes and note any fee questions or concerns. Only record fee consent if it was covered. Write about the client's understanding of and satisfaction with the fee structure.

subsections.title: Service satisfaction
subsections.guidance: Record client feedback on service delivery as direct quotes in narrative form. Document any service gaps or improvement needs and note communication effectiveness. Write this section as a brief natural language mini paragraph instead of bullet points, capturing the client's overall satisfaction with service quality.

sections.title: Next steps
sections.guidance: Write a comprehensive narrative about what actions were agreed upon and the implementation process.

subsections.title: Action items (list)
subsections.guidance: List clear next steps with owners and timeframes as bullet points. Don't include information from "Documents required". Focus on specific commitments made by both adviser and client.

subsections.title: Action items (table)
subsections.guidance: In addition to the above list of actions, create a table of actions, with columns for: owner, due date (if discussed), action, dependency. Include all agreed actions with clear accountability and timing.

subsections.title: Review schedule
subsections.guidance: Document next review timing and focus in narrative form. Record any interim check-in requirements and note any required preparation discussed. Write about the agreed ongoing review process and communication preferences.

sections.title: Financial planning data
sections.guidance:
Create a comprehensive table capturing updated financial information discussed during the review. Use three columns with headers "Financial Data", "Category", and "Current Value/Status". Include:

Updated income sources with specific amounts and any changes

Current asset values and any additions or disposals since last review

Debt balances and terms, including any refinancing or new borrowings

Investment holdings and performance with current values

Pension balances and contribution levels with any strategy changes

Cash positions and other relevant financial data discussed

Only include information that was actually discussed or updated during the review meeting.

sections.title: Fiduciary/Suitability impacting data
sections.guidance:
Create a suitability assessment table with three columns: the first column listing factors, the second column providing details as of the review date, and a third column with relevant comments. Document what was confirmed or updated during the review for:

Demographics (any changes to family status, location, life stage)

Occupation (employment changes or developments affecting planning)

Net Worth (updated estimates and composition reflecting recent changes)

Liquid Net Worth (current available funds and accessibility)

Annual Income (confirmed current income levels and sources)

Liquidity Needs (any changes to short-term requirements or timing)

Investment Objective (confirmation or updates to goals and priorities)

Risk Tolerance (current assessment and any changes since last review)

Time Horizon (updated timeframes for goals and any adjustments)

Changes in Financial Situation (recent developments affecting planning and strategy)

sections.title: Internal notes
sections.guidance: Write narrative sections as needed for key observations.

subsections.title: Key insights
subsections.guidance: Record observations about decision-making style (sole/joint), financial sophistication level, preferred communication style and frequency, family dynamics that might impact advice in narrative form. Note changes in client engagement or sophistication and family dynamics affecting advice.

subsections.title: Points to watch
subsections.guidance: Note any red flags or concerns about ability to implement advice in narrative form. Record potential complexities requiring specialist input and document any credibility concerns. Document areas requiring closer monitoring and note potential future challenges.

subsections.title: Opportunities
subsections.guidance: Record potential strategies to investigate in narrative form. Record future advice opportunities or solutions to explore and document potential professional referral needs. Note cross-referral opportunities and document potential strategy extensions.

subsections.title: Additional notes
subsections.guidance: Record any other insights relevant for future meetings or strategy development in narrative form. Document any other insights relevant for ongoing advice relationship including any vulnerable client indicators observed under FCA guidelines or confirm "No vulnerable client indicators identified." Do not include if there are none.

subsections.title: Not covered
subsections.guidance: Record here any sections of the above that we didn't cover during the meeting.

sections.title: Compliance
questions: Did the adviser clearly explain the purpose and scope of the review meeting?
Were any limitations on the advice scope clearly explained upfront?
Did the adviser raise their disclosures including FCA authorisation details and compliance?
Did the adviser ask about any changes in the client's personal circumstances?
Did the adviser ask about any changes in the client's goals and objectives?
Did the client understand key risks and implications?
Were next steps and timelines clearly communicated?

sections.title: Email draft
sections.guidance:
Create a follow up email to the client, focusing on the key points discussed and using the below format. Max one sentence bullets. Use the below format:

Hi [client],

Great to discuss the below today!

[summarise the meeting in 3-5 bullet points]

I've noted the following actions for you:

[include any action items for the client, and only include this section if there are action items for the client]

Thanks,

sections.title: Paraplanning request
sections.guidance: Make a paraplanning request to my planner based on the conversation. Format as an email with bullet points for key details. Use new paragraphs where necessary. Max 250 words. Use the format:

subsections.title: Hi,
subsections.guidance:
I discussed the below with [client] today. Could you please help me:

[summarise paraplanning related actions or next steps for my firm]

Thanks,
